# Pay3 External (B2B) API

> B2B API for partners who use Pay3's card issuance, identity verification and payment infrastructure behind their own UI.
> Partners obtain an OAuth access token with their client ID and API key, then register users, run KYC, top up from their pool and issue cards.
> Base URL (sandbox): https://api-staging.pay-3.io/functions/v1/external-service
> Base URL (production): https://api.pay-3.io/functions/v1/external-service
> The machine-readable contract for every endpoint is openapi.yaml.

## Guides

- [Quickstart](api/quickstart.md): from access token to a virtual card
- [Authentication](api/authentication.md): OAuth access tokens, Bearer rules, tenant isolation
- [Environments](api/environments.md): sandbox vs production, deposit rails, separate credentials
- [Endpoints](api/endpoints.md): users, KYC, cards, insufficient-balance semantics, error format
- [Users](api/users.md): listing and looking up your users, KYC stages
- [Partner Pool](api/pool.md): balance, deposit address, top-up transfers, ledger, source-IP allowlist
- [Referral Codes](api/referral-codes.md): referral codes and sign-up links
- [Idempotency](api/idempotency.md): Idempotency-Key semantics
- [Webhooks](api/webhooks.md): events, signature verification, retries

## Reference

- [OpenAPI](openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification
